environment: macOS 26.6, Apple M5, ANGLE Metal, headless Chrome, 1280x800 DPR1
method: One scene at a time. Complete hydration + 2s idle, two unmeasured 4s gestures separated by 4s idle, then 3 repeated 5s rotations. Native pointer down/up; elapsed-time pointer trajectory. Frame durations from the existing bounded diagnostics: last 240 active navigation/damping samples per repetition; idle frames excluded. Fixed quality and DPR; no quality compensation. Public fixture mounts independently with existing scene policy; no live token. Boot reports the existing first-interactive readiness marker (controls installed and presented frames), not end-to-end user task completion.

renderTiming.method: Independent ABBA diagnostic. Same viewport, DPR, camera and gesture as navigation trials. One unmeasured 4s gesture; enable/reset existing CPU/GPU diagnostic; one 5s measured gesture per private/public mount. CPU is command submission only. GPU uses existing disjoint timer queries when supported. Each diagnostic retains at most 240 samples. These instrumented samples are not pooled with rAF comparisons.
